title: observability-automation-private-installs-prometheus-grafana-helm-terraform
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Automates Prometheus/Grafana, log shipping, dashboards, and alert provisioning for Private installs; adds Helm charts and Terraform modules for observability stack; includes upgrade/rollback hooks.
description: Motivation: Private installations currently require a manual runbook to provision Prometheus, Grafana, log shipping, dashboards, and alerting. This PR automates that work across Helm and Terraform surfaces for the private-installer and provides upgrade and rollback hooks for safe operator-driven upgrades. Scope: 1) new Terraform modules to provision observability namespaces, persistent storage, and alertmanager config; 2) Helm chart updates for prometheus and grafana with opinionated defaults for private installs; 3) fluent-bit fluentd connectors + Loki/Cloud-compatible forwarders for log shipping; 4) dashboard provisioning via Grafana Mixin + provisioning API; 5) upgrade/rollback hooks integrated into the private-installer CLI and Helm lifecycle; 6) integration tests and docs. Checklist: [x] Terraform modules added and documented; [x] Helm charts linted and versioned; [x] Dashboards and alerts templated and tested; [x] E2E private-deploy smoke test passing; [x] Migration/rollback documented. Commits summary: added terraform/observability module and examples; introduced helm/prometheus chart updates (resource requests, PV templates, service monitor CRDs); add helm/grafana provisioning config + dashboards; add fluent-bit filters and loki output plugin; private-installer: hook to apply observability modules and a dry-run mode; tests: e2e/private-obs smoke test and terraform-validate in CI; docs: private-installs/observability.md. Changed areas (high level): private-installer/ (install hooks, upgrade/rollback), terraform/modules/observability/ (main module + examples), helm/charts/prometheus/ (values.yaml, templates, Chart.yaml), helm/charts/grafana/ (provisioning, dashboards), tooling/ci/ (e2e-private-deploy job), docs/private-installs/observability.md. Testing performed: local helm lint, terraform validate, integration on a gated k8s test cluster (private-vpc emulate), smoke dashboards verified in Grafana provisioning, alertmanager alert routes validated with test alerts. Upgrade notes: the installer will detect existing prometheus release and run a canary upgrade: deploy new chart to a canary namespace, run smoke queries, then swap. Rollback: Helm rollback via release history + terraform state restore; private-installer exposes a --rollback flag that orchestrates both steps. Backwards compatibility: default values preserve previous release names and service names; explicit migration steps documented. Followups: automated alert tuning (ENG-1489), RBAC hardening for grafana provisioning (security review), metrics retention policy policy control UI. References: ENG-1423, internal runbook link: linear/ENG-1423, jira SUP-1023.
